title: Return structured PDF generation diagnostics
description: Return stable structured diagnostics for missing resources, unsupported scene nodes, overflow, and renderer failures, and make unsuccessful generation incapable of creating a downloadable success or audit record.
acceptanceCriteria: Diagnostics use stable codes, severity, affected page/position/node/resource identifiers, and actionable messages
Missing fonts and assets produce named resource diagnostics
Unsupported scene nodes and content overflow produce distinct diagnostics
Unexpected renderer failures are contained and reported without exposing private content or stack traces in user messages
Any error-severity diagnostic or renderer failure returns no successful PDF bytes, download action, or print preparation
The prior durable project draft remains unchanged after failure

steps.details: Create application-owned diagnostic codes and payloads for resource missing/invalid, unsupported node, overflow, invalid geometry, renderer failure, and cancellation.
Walk canonical renderer inputs, collect stable ordered diagnostics, and refuse invocation when required resources, node support, bounds, or resource limits fail.
Catch adapter/library failures at the boundary, map them to a safe diagnostic with internal logging that excludes private label text and binary bytes, and discard partial output.
Model generation as success or failure so download URL creation and print-preparation persistence are reachable only from a complete successful result.
Show an accessible diagnostic summary and detailed list with corrective actions, while preserving editor state and providing retry after correction.
Exercise missing font, missing asset, unsupported node, overflow, and thrown renderer fixtures, asserting named diagnostics and absence of bytes, download controls, and success records.

technicalNotes: Warnings may accompany success only when the contract explicitly classifies them as non-fatal.
Revoke any temporary object URL when superseded or on cleanup.
